output.reason: The brief backs its point with numbers. Once you count only staff who meet the 18-month eligibility rule, remote and office promotion rates are nearly the same, and its expected-rate figure accounts for almost all of the gap. It is honest about the small sample and the visibility effects it couldn't test, and it gives clear next steps.
